disposition.reason: Docket 56-4-10 Vtec appeals a District 6 Environmental Commission coordinator's ruling that an Act 250 subdivision application for the McBride parcel was incomplete; it is an Act 250 appeal, not an appeal of a municipal land-use decision, and the Town of South Hero subdivision permit is expressly not at issue.

evidence.quote: decision of the District Coordinator of the District 6 Environmental Commission
determining that their Act 250 applications to subdivide and auction three lots from each of two large parcels were incomplete.
Town of South Hero subdivision permit, not at issue in this appeal.
sized to serve the standard four-bedroom single family house, on each lot.

judgments.note: The appeal is from the Act 250 District Coordinator's incompleteness ruling (Jurisdictional Opinion # 6-007), a state Act 250 proceeding; the municipal subdivision permit was not appealed. The shared decision also decides 55-4-10 Vtec (Wright parcel); only the McBride parcel facts concern this docket.
Act 250 appeal from a District Commission coordinator; the town subdivision permit is 'not at issue in this appeal'.

The McBride parcel is to be subdivided into three lots (one containing an existing house), each with state water/wastewater permits sized for a four-bedroom single-family house, which reads as a subdivision creating house lots; but the applicants say they do not intend residential development themselves and sell at auction. Does not affect the exclusion.

history.note: Excluded: Act 250 completeness appeal (McBride parcel), not a municipal appeal.
